description: 嗯嗯，看看词表外现在有哪些词

arguments.command:
python -c "
import sys, io
sys.path.insert(0, 'D:/github/miniBot')
from core.meme import SUGGESTED_TAGS
vocab=set(SUGGESTED_TAGS)
import sqlite3
c=sqlite3.connect('D:/github/miniBot/data/memes.db')
cur=c.cursor()
cur.execute('select tag from meme_tags')
alltags=[r[0] for r in cur.fetchall()]
outside=sorted(set(t for t in alltags if t not in vocab))
out=io.open('D:/github/miniBot/data/workspace/main/outside_tags.txt','w',encoding='utf-8')
out.write('词表外标签共 %d 个：\n'%len(outside))
for t in outside:
    out.write('  %s\n'%t)
out.close()
print('outside:',len(outside))
"
